name: SliderTokens
summary: The slider. Expressive replaced the round thumb with a tall thin bar and thickened the track to match.

TrackHeight.summary: Both halves of the track; Expressive made them equal and thick.

PressedHandleWidth.summary: The handle while pressed — narrower, so the value under it stays visible.

HandleHeight.summary: The handle, which stands taller than the track.

HandlePadding.summary: The gap the handle leaves on either side, so the track does not run under it.

StopIndicatorSize.summary: The dot marking the far end of the track.

StopIndicatorTrailingSpace.summary: The gap before the stop dot.

InactiveTrackColor.summary: The track ahead of the handle.

StateLayerColor.summary: The state layer around the handle.

DisabledActiveTrackOpacity.summary: Alpha applied to the disabled active track.

DisabledInactiveTrackOpacity.summary: Alpha applied to the disabled inactive track.

DisabledHandleOpacity.summary: Alpha applied to the disabled handle.
